_comment: 8 ranks with thresholds (wealth, population, buildings) and unlocked powers. Filled in during Phase 2. D2 (Phase 14): each rank's requirements is now an ARRAY of alternative requirement-groups — a ruler qualifies by satisfying ANY ONE group in full. Group 0 is always the original Prestige (palace/cathedral) path, unchanged in shape from before D2. Duke-Margrave add a Land/Population alt path (no palace, no downstream-gated resources — usable from turn one). Archbishop-Kaiser add a Commerce alt path (wealth + tradingHousesMin, no palace/cathedral) instead, since trading houses only unlock at Margrave (commerce.tradingHouse.requiresRank in data/buildings.json) and so cannot be a genuine alternative any earlier — see docs/d2-rank-gate-design.md.

_populationNote: Calibrated against what the simulation actually sustains. Phase 8 raised per-peasant consumption from 0.5 to 9.0, which made food a genuine constraint and LOWERED the sustainable population: realms now grow toward the land they can work (~2,400-2,600 peasants on the land an AI typically buys) and are knocked back hard by drought sequences. Earlier figures ran to 20,000 (Phase 0, before the population model existed) and then 4,200 (Phase 6, before food mattered); both made the senior ranks unreachable.
